RENOVA - Legal Framework and Data Protection

WHO WE ARE

Renova is a sustainable technology platform that promotes recycling through smart deposit machines, a mobile application, and a website. Our goal is to encourage the circular economy by rewarding users who actively participate in the proper disposal of recyclable materials.

We are committed to operating with transparency, social responsibility, and adherence to Mexican legislation regarding the protection of personal data.

TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF SERVICE

By registering and using Renova (mobile application, website, or smart deposit machines), the user accepts the following terms:

1. Proper use of the platform:
The user agrees to provide truthful information and to use the system only for authorized purposes (recycling, accumulating points, redeeming rewards).

2. Account and credentials:
The user is responsible for the confidentiality of their access credentials. Renova is not responsible for unauthorized access caused by user negligence.

3. Rewards and points:
Accumulated points do not constitute cash, unless otherwise specified in active promotions. Renova may modify the accumulation and redemption rules with prior notice.

4. Service availability:
While Renova seeks to guarantee platform continuity, it is not responsible for interruptions caused by technical failures, scheduled maintenance, or external factors.

5. Prohibitions:
It is prohibited to tamper with smart deposit machines, register false information, or engage in fraudulent activities that affect the system or other users.

6. Policy acceptance:
The use of Renova implies full acceptance of this privacy and security policy, as well as future updates communicated to the user.

PRIVACY POLICY AND DATA USE

Introduction:
At Renova, we protect the privacy of our users and treat their personal data responsibly. This policy explains how we collect, use, store, and share information.

Data we collect:
- Identity data: copy of ID, selfie photo for validation.
- Contact data: name, email, phone number.
- Usage data: recycling history, accumulated points, transactions and rewards.
- Technical data: IP address, device, app activity logs.
- Location data: only when using a smart deposit machine.

Purpose of processing:
- Validate identity and access to services.
- Allow use of smart deposit machines and application.
- Manage points and rewards.
- Issue environmental reports.
- Improve user experience.
- Comply with legal obligations.

Consent:
The user gives express consent by registering and accepting this policy. Consent can be revoked at any time by request via email, which may result in service suspension.

Information security:
Renova applies technical and organizational measures to protect data:
- Encryption of data in transit and at rest.
- Secure administrator authentication.
- Periodic monitoring and audits.

Data transfer:
Data is not shared with third parties, except:
- Service providers supporting operations (e.g., payments, cloud storage).
- Legal or regulatory requirements.
- Merger or business restructuring processes.

User rights (ARCO):
According to the Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP), the user can:
- Access their data.
- Rectify it if incorrect.
- Cancel it when desired.
- Oppose its processing.

Requests must be sent to: soyrenovaapp@gmail.com

Retention:
Data will be retained only for the time necessary to fulfill the described purposes and in accordance with applicable legislation.

Policy changes:
We may update this policy at any time. Changes will be communicated in the app or to the registered email. Continued use implies acceptance of the current version.

CONTACT US

If you have questions or wish to exercise your privacy rights, contact us at:

📧 soyrenovaapp@gmail.com
📍 Manzanillo, Colima, Mexico

1. Information we collect

We collect information you provide directly to us, such as name, email, and application usage data.

2. Use of information

We use the collected information to provide, maintain, and improve our services, as well as to communicate with you.

3. Sharing information

We do not share your personal information with third parties without your consent, except when necessary to provide our services.

4. Security

We implement security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access and misuse.

5. Your rights

You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information at any time.

To create an account, download the RENOVA app from your app store, open it, and select \'Sign Up\'. Fill in your personal details such as name, email, and password. You must upload a photo of your ID and a selfie to verify your identity. An administrator will review your information and activate your account.

On the login screen, tap \'Forgot my password\'. Enter your registered email address and you\'ll receive a link to reset your password. Follow the instructions in the email to create a new secure password.

You can update your personal information based on your account verification status:

- Rejected account: You will be able to modify all your personal data.
- Pending verification account: You will be able to update your email address and password.
- Verified account: It will not be possible to modify your information.

To edit your information, access your profile in the application and edit the information you need.

For every recyclable material you deposit in our smart containers, you earn RENOVA points. The container uses artificial intelligence (GPT-4o) to automatically identify whether you deposited PET plastic or aluminum. Points are instantly added to your account and can be redeemed for rewards at partner businesses (100 points = $1.00 MXN).

We currently accept two materials: PET plastic bottles and aluminum cans. The container\'s AI system automatically identifies the material you deposit using computer vision. More recyclable materials will be supported soon.

In the app, you\'ll find a map showing all nearby RENOVA smart containers. These containers are equipped with Raspberry Pi 4, cameras, and sensors for automatic classification. You can also check the fill level of each container before visiting.

The point values are:
• Regular PET plastic bottle: +10 points ($0.10 MXN)
• Crushed PET plastic bottle: +15 points ($0.15 MXN)
• Regular aluminum can: +30 points ($0.30 MXN)
• Crushed aluminum can: +35 points ($0.35 MXN)

Earn extra points by crushing your materials before depositing them.
No, recycling points do not expire. You can use them whenever you want. However, some special rewards from partner businesses may have limited-time availability.

Go to the \'Store\' section in the app, browse the catalog of partner businesses, and find the reward you want. If you have enough points, visit that business (you can see its address in the reward information), show your profile to the cashier, and select the product you wish to redeem.

We offer a wide variety of rewards in partner businesses: discounts on products, food and beverage vouchers, cleaning products, access to services, and more. The catalog is constantly updated. You can also unlock special badges: Eco Warrior (100 pts), Recycler Pro (500 pts), Green Hero (1000 pts), and Planet Saver (2500 pts).
Redeemed rewards are non-refundable. Once a reward is redeemed, the corresponding points are permanently deducted from your account. Be sure to review the reward details.

A business partnership is a company or store that joins RENOVA to offer rewards to our users. As a partner, you gain environmentally conscious customers, increase your visibility in the app, and contribute to community sustainability. You can manage your earned points from the administrative web panel.
Contact us via email at \'soyrenovaapp@gmail.com\'. Our team will guide you through the process of registering your business as a RENOVA partner.

As a partner business, when a user redeems points at your establishment, those points are converted to Mexican pesos at a rate of 100 points = $1.00 MXN. You can check your balance and transactions anytime.

You can check your accumulated balance at any time through your app. The withdrawal process is managed through the platform — you can withdraw whenever you like. Contact our team for more details about the payment process.
No, RENOVA is completely free for recycling users. There are no registration or monthly fees. Business registration is also free.
You can contact us via email at soyrenovaapp@gmail.com. Our team is available to help with any questions or issues.

RENOVA is currently in a prototype phase as an applied technology development project. The system has been successfully validated with controlled tests, achieving a 98% communication success rate and a 4.2-second response time. Visit our website to learn about the project status and future implementations.
